title: Tensor-compatible isomorphisms preserve the unit
statement: Let \(C,D\) be monoidal categories, \(F,G:C\to D\) functors, and \(a:F\simeq G\) a natural isomorphism. For \(H=F,G\), let \(d_H(X,Y):H(X\otimes Y)\simeq HX\otimes HY\) be a family of isomorphisms and \(e_H:H1_C\simeq1_D\) an isomorphism satisfying \(d_H(1_C,X);(e_H\mathbin{\triangleright}HX);\lambda_{HX}=H(\lambda_X)\). Suppose \(a_{X\otimes Y};d_G(X,Y)=d_F(X,Y);(a_X\otimes a_Y)\) for all \(X,Y\). Then \(a_{1_C};e_G=e_F\). Semicolon denotes composition in application order. No naturality or associativity axiom for the families \(d_H\) is required.

proof.text: Apply naturality of a to the left unitor at 1. Replace the two functor images of this unitor by their left-unit laws and use binary tensor compatibility. Cancel dF_{1,1}. Naturality of the left unitor and tensor interchange show eF tensor a_1 equals (a_1 eG) tensor a_1. Cancel tensoring on the left by the invertible a_1. Tensoring on the right by F1 is faithful since F1≅1: compose with the tensor of eF and use right-unitor naturality. This gives the asserted equality.

theorem tensorIso_preserves_unit
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    (F G : C ⥤ D) (a : F ≅ G)
    (dF : ∀ X Y : C, F.obj (X ⊗ Y) ≅ F.obj X ⊗ F.obj Y)
    (dG : ∀ X Y : C, G.obj (X ⊗ Y) ≅ G.obj X ⊗ G.obj Y)
    (eF : F.obj (𝟙_ C) ≅ 𝟙_ D) (eG : G.obj (𝟙_ C) ≅ 𝟙_ D)
    (hF : ∀ X, (dF (𝟙_ C) X).hom ≫ eF.hom ▷ F.obj X ≫
      (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom = F.map (λ_ X).hom)
    (hG : ∀ X, (dG (𝟙_ C) X).hom ≫ eG.hom ▷ G.obj X ≫
      (λ_ (G.obj X)).hom = G.map (λ_ X).hom)
    (hc : ∀ X Y, a.hom.app (X ⊗ Y) ≫ (dG X Y).hom =
      (dF X Y).hom ≫ (a.hom.app X ⊗ₘ a.hom.app Y)) :
    a.hom.app (𝟙_ C) ≫ eG.hom = eF.hom
